Nice restaurant and good menu.
May 2020
Nice restaurant and good menu. Staff spoke good English and were friendly. However....ordered garlic bread first and it arrived after the pizza. Ordered bacon with the pizza and didn’t receive. Tried to charge us for 3 pizzas, but we are only 2 people and had 2 pizzas. Charged for extra mushrooms, but did not order. When we questioned the bill they changed straight away, but did not apologize or question us - it looked like it was deliberately added to the bill. It’s a shame, as the food and atmosphere was good. We would be happy to go back regularly to this restaurant, but now we don’t trust them.
